Every reconstruction of production relations in history has emerged from the collision between the bottlenecks of old organizational forms and the power of new technologies. From the street vendors of the 1980s, to the legal entities established by the 1999 "Sole Proprietorship Enterprise Law," and further to the mobile internet wave of "mass entrepreneurship and innovation" in 2014—each leap in China's individual economy policy has been a collective response to the times.

Today, with the widespread adoption of infrastructure like Agent and OpenClaw, super entrepreneurs are presented with a natural opportunity to drive innovation and transformation based on AI technology. Innovative models such as OPC (One Person Company) and SE (Super Entrepreneur) are propelling the arrival of the fourth wave.

excerpt_i18n.en: The e-commerce version of "Wukong" is here! Recently, Alibaba officially launched the world's first enterprise-level AI-native work platform—"Wukong." In the e-commerce sector, the core operational capabilities of Taobao and Tmall will be gradually integrated in the form of Skills (skill modules). Merchants can combine these Skills like building blocks and create their own AI workflows on Wukong, assembling an AI Agent team that is on standby around the clock, covering all aspects from store setup, product selection, marketing, operations, to shipping. Even more impressively, beyond e-commerce operations, merchants can also access various professional Skills such as finance, legal, design, and technical development through Wukong, forming a complete AI Agent team for enterprise functions. In the future, merchants will only need to make key decisions, while tedious preliminary tasks like research, data analysis, and proposal drafting will all be handled by the AI team, ushering in a new era of AI-driven enterprise operations. In the initial launch, "AI employees" supporting core operational areas such as Taobao product material optimization, store operation weekly report analysis, and 1688 same-product search will be the first to be deployed. Additionally, merchants can standardize their operational experience into Skill packages, building AI Agents tailored to personalized operations. Taking "optimizing product materials" as an example, with Wukong, merchants only need to arrange the corresponding AI workflow. The AI Agent will automatically complete preliminary tasks like "data analysis → providing suggestions." After the merchant confirms the updates with one click, the AI Agent will automatically execute "material creation → updating."
excerpt_i18n.es: ¡Llega la versión "Lobster" del comercio electrónico! Recientemente, Alibaba lanzó oficialmente la primera plataforma de trabajo nativa de IA a nivel empresarial del mundo, "Wukong". En el ámbito del comercio electrónico, las capacidades centrales de gestión de Taobao y Tmall se integrarán gradualmente en forma de módulos de habilidad (Skill). Los comerciantes podrán combinar estos Skills como si fueran bloques de construcción y crear sus propios flujos de trabajo de IA en Wukong, formando un equipo de Agentes de IA que estará disponible en cualquier momento y lugar, cubriendo todas las etapas como apertura de tiendas, selección de productos, marketing, operaciones y envíos. Lo más impresionante es que, además de la gestión del comercio electrónico, los comerciantes también podrán acceder a través de Wukong a diversos Skills profesionales como finanzas, asuntos legales, diseño, desarrollo tecnológico, entre otros, conformando un conjunto completo.
